set.body: PHRF-29 independent architectural review at2005f4a9 found ParallelBlockExecutor workers pull indefinitely while earlier blocks are slow; pending TreeMap can retain arbitrarily many payloads despite its claimed <=workers bound. Sink throws are misclassified or escape, worker construction/Future.get failures can bypass shutdown. Repair with <=workers in-flight windows and ordered drain, explicit typed failure/cancellation propagation, finally cleanup. Regression: latch-block block0 while other workers finish; no more thanworkers process starts beforerelease; orderedreceipts; sinkthrow and workerfactorythrow failures; bounded cancellation cleanup. Shared sequential sink throws must produce SinkFailed. Both affected JVM and shared JS tests required before trial integration.
set.title: Bound parallel profile execution and preserve typed failure cleanup
